articles.title: Court Square Capital Partners Announces Acquisition of CallTower
articles.mainIdea: Court Square Capital Partners Announces Acquisition of CallTower
articles.summary: Business Wire: Court Square Capital Partners Announces Acquisition of CallTower. NEW YORK, April 02, 2026--Court Square Capital Partners ("Court Square"), a leading U.S. middle market private equity firm, today announced it has acquired a majority stake in CallTower (the "Company"), a global leader in enterprise-class cloud communications and collaboration solutions. Court Square is acquiring the company from BV Investment Partners, which acquired a majority stake in 2023.

articles.title: BV Investment Partners Announces Sale of CallTower
articles.mainIdea: BV Investment Partners Announces Sale of CallTower
articles.summary: PR Newswire: BV Investment Partners Announces Sale of CallTower. BV Investment Partners ("BV"), a middle-market private equity firm focused on tech-enabled business services and solutions, today announced the majority sale of CallTower, a global leader in managed cloud communications, contact center and collaboration solutions, to Court Square Capital Partners. BV and CallTower management will retain a minority stake in the business. Related tickers mentioned: MSFT.
